proposal.reason: Primary change is in P2P IPC registration/deregistration flow to support multi-segment physical mappings (segment discovery, export/import, offset handling, and teardown) in src/transport/p2p.cc, so transport is the main review module. Add memory because alloc/free/mapping helpers in src/include/alloc.h now change segment-aware unmap/address-free semantics and ownership cleanup behavior. Add network because src/proxy.cc/src/include/proxy.h introduce proxy-side FD batch query and per-connection imported-handle tracking/cleanup, which is a substantive proxy lifecycle/resource-management change.
